premise: All autumn day Squirrel hides her best hazelnut behind her back whenever curious Acorn comes near; at dusk she brings it out for Bear cub before his long winter sleep, promising to keep it safe till he wakes up hungry in spring.
inspiration: The Little Red Hen (folk), turned inside out: the one who seems to keep everything for herself is saving it for a friend.
lesson: Sometimes a secret is really a gift waiting for its moment.

en-US.title: Squirrel Hides a Present
en-US.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6 16s} {sfx:leaves} It was autumn, and leaves came twirling down. {squirrel:enter} Squirrel had a secret: her very best hazelnut. Along came {acorn:enter} Acorn, curious as ever. {squirrel:face surprised} {squirrel:live hold} Squirrel hid the nut behind her back. Innocent as anything. [curious] What's behind your back? asked Acorn. Nothing! said Squirrel. {acorn:live} Acorn made a wish: I wish I knew! All day long it went: {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop} What's behind your back? Nothing! [giggles] {canvas:sunset 0.7 30s} Then, as the sun went down, {bear:enter} Bear cub came toddling by. [yawns] Winter's coming, he said. Time for my long sleep. {squirrel:live resume} Squirrel brought out her hazelnut and hugged it. Then {squirrel:go to bear} she bounded over to Bear cub. [softly] This is yours, she said. I'll keep it safe till you wake up hungry in the spring. {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} Bear cub smiled, {bear:live hold} gave a great big yawn, and nodded off. {sfx:snore} {acorn:face surprised} [whispers] So THAT was the secret! said Acorn. {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:hearts} Not a secret any more, said Squirrel. A promise.

es-ES.title: Ardilla esconde un regalo
es-ES.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6 16s} {sfx:leaves} Era otoño, y las hojas bajaban dando vueltas. {squirrel:enter} Ardilla tenía un secreto: su mejor avellana. Y llegó {acorn:enter} Bellota, curiosa como siempre. {squirrel:face surprised} {squirrel:live hold} Ardilla escondió la avellana detrás de la espalda. Con carita de inocente. [curious] ¿Qué tienes ahí detrás? preguntó Bellota. ¡Nada!, dijo Ardilla. {acorn:live} Bellota pidió un deseo: ¡ojalá lo supiera! Y así todo el día. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop} ¿Qué tienes ahí detrás? ¡Nada! [giggles] {canvas:sunset 0.7 30s} Entonces, cuando el sol se ponía, {bear:enter} Osito llegó caminando despacito. [yawns] Ya viene el invierno, dijo. Me toca mi sueño largo. {squirrel:live resume} Ardilla sacó su avellana y le dio un abrazo. Luego {squirrel:go to bear} fue dando brincos hasta Osito. [softly] Es para ti, le dijo. Te la guardo hasta la primavera, para cuando despiertes con hambre. {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} Osito sonrió, {bear:live hold} dio un bostezo enorme y se quedó dormido. {sfx:snore} {acorn:face surprised} [whispers] ¡Así que ese era el secreto! dijo Bellota. {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:hearts} Ya no es un secreto, dijo Ardilla. Es una promesa.
